notes.title: Patch 1.2.
Patch 1.1.12
notes.content:
Nothing much has changed, but the new version of the engine causes the patch to be quite large.
Please don't be sad about it.
If you come across any new bugs and/or glitches, please submit them to The GoD Unit Discord server. Thank you.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.9. update:
notes.content:
- Fixed the issues with the newly added saturation change option (Probably. If you still have any issues with the game being black-and-white sometimes or anything else related to game colors, please report them on Steam or The GoD Unit Discord server at https://discord.gg/A3rvfT2);
- Made gamepad look more frame rate independent (you might need to readjust your gamepad look sensitivity).
